ranking.reason: Unchanged from P2: a dedicated converter that meets every applied value, takes all 8 thermocouple types while the type is not found (V233), detects an open thermocouple on chip, and has the highest input rating found (±45 V). Stocked at both vendors (JLCPCB 11,489, Digi-Key 12,023).

New from P3. Meets every applied value: 24 bits, gains to 128 on a 2.048 V internal reference, an on-chip temperature sensor of ±0.5 °C max over 0 to 75 °C for the cold junction, and 10 µA burn-out current sources that drive an open thermocouple to a full-scale reading. Below the MAX31856: linearisation and cold-junction compensation run in firmware, the burn-out sources corrupt a reading while on and are switched in only for a fault check, the thermocouple needs bias resistors for its common-mode voltage, and its inputs are rated to AVDD + 0.3 V. Above the Microchip parts for its cold-junction accuracy and stock (JLCPCB 16,905, Digi-Key 660).

As P2: I²C with open and short detection for all 8 types. Below the ADS1220 for its ±4.0 °C hot-junction limit, the 100 kHz I²C ceiling that holds its bus to Standard-mode, and a JLCPCB stock of 104 against a gate of 50.

As P2: the most accurate I²C converter found (±1.5 °C hot junction). JLCPCB 72 against a gate of 50 and Digi-Key 2, so its second source is the less accurate MCP96L01 as an alternate; shares its 100 kHz I²C ceiling.
As P2: meets every applied value and stocks well at both vendors, but takes type K only while the type is not found, and its inputs are rated only to VCC + 0.3 V.
As P2: type K only, T- grounded for open detection, the widest errors on the list (±8 °C at 3.3 V) and a -20 °C floor on its operating range.

report.value: FRAM. 2,048 bytes, 5 records of 396 bytes; 10^12 read/writes a byte; no write busy wait; I²C to 1 MHz. One-byte word address, so a record is (2 + 396) x 9 = 3,582 SCL cycles: 9.0 ms at 400 kHz, 3.6 ms at 1 MHz, with interrupts on. Takes all of 0x50 to 0x57 (3 memory-address bits in the device address). 2.7 to 3.6 V; retention 10 years at 85 °C, 95 years at 55 °C. JLCPCB 25,316 (15:45:51Z), Digi-Key 0 (15:47:01Z); second source the FM24CL16B-GTR as alternate

EEPROM, Q8 option EEPROM, first-ranked of that option (q-alternative). 32,768 bytes; 64-byte pages; endurance per 4-byte group 1,200,000 at 85 °C and 4,000,000 at 25 °C or below (50 °C not stated; the 85 °C figure is used). A 396-byte record is 7 page writes; 73 slots of 448 bytes written in turn give 73 x 1,200,000 = 87,600,000 saves. Each page write is (3 + 64) x 9 = 603 SCL cycles plus tW 5 ms max (3.2 ms typical): at most 45.6 ms a save at 400 kHz, 39.2 ms at 1 MHz, with interrupts on. Address 1010 C2 C1 C0 from a configurable register, 000 (0x50) as delivered; 1.65 to 5.5 V; retention 200 years at 55 °C. JLCPCB 125,256 (15:45:54Z), Digi-Key 835 (15:47:04Z)

EEPROM. 8,192 bytes; 32-byte pages; endurance per 4-byte group 1,200,000 at 85 °C and 4,000,000 at 25 °C or below (50 °C not stated; the 85 °C figure is used). A 396-byte record is 13 page writes; 19 slots of 416 bytes give 19 x 1,200,000 = 22,800,000 saves. Each page write is (3 + 32) x 9 = 315 SCL cycles plus tW 5 ms max: at most 75.2 ms a save at 400 kHz, 69.1 ms at 1 MHz, with interrupts on. Address 1010 E2 E1 E0, 0x50 to 0x57; 1.8 to 5.5 V; retention over 200 years. JLCPCB 168,822 (15:45:53Z), Digi-Key 15,188 (15:47:02Z)

EEPROM. 32,768 bytes; 64-byte pages; 1,000,000 program/erase cycles stated at 5 V, 25 °C, page mode (50 °C and 3.3 V not stated); 73 rotating slots of 7 pages give 73,000,000 saves at that condition. Each page write is (3 + 64) x 9 = 603 SCL cycles plus tWR 5 ms max: at most 45.6 ms a save at 400 kHz, 39.2 ms at 1 MHz, with interrupts on. Address 1010 A2 A1 A0, 0x50 to 0x57; 1.8 to 5.5 V; retention 100 years. JLCPCB 65,356 (15:45:56Z), Digi-Key 19,585 (15:47:06Z)
